purpose: Select one finite historical-only Campaign061 mechanism from frozen definitions and source schemas before reading any Campaign061 minute row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

candidate_design_catalog.reason: The score isolates persistence of total within-half realized variance across adjacent accepted sessions while discarding sign and clock shape; this is a cross-session volatility-regime mechanism rather than a same-day volatility level, scale-free profile similarity, or directional recurrence statistic.
A signed change requires an ungrounded higher-versus-lower direction choice. The selected bounded symmetric stability coefficient freezes one scale-comparison mechanism.
Only the exact prior accepted market session and the full fixed 238-return grid are allowed; no lag, window, or half-session search is admitted.
Campaign057 and Campaign060 already terminalized cross-session clock-shape and sign-recurrence families; Campaign061 aggregates squared returns before comparing session scale.
A zero-variance day makes the ratio undefined for the economic mechanism and a missing stock session must never be bridged.
Campaign061 computes one direct close-derived statistic and loads no terminal score into its formula.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_day_over_day_realized_variance_stability_238b
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A stable stock-specific intraday volatility regime across adjacent sessions may indicate persistent information intensity and liquidity conditions, making the next three-session path more regular than an abrupt volatility-regime transition.
selected_candidate.formula: For signal session t and its immediately preceding accepted market session t-1, form 119 signed adjacent natural-log close returns independently inside each 120-close half. Let RV_t and RV_t_minus_1 be the sums of squared values across their exact 238 positions. Return 2 times min(RV_t,RV_t_minus_1) divided by RV_t plus RV_t_minus_1.
selected_candidate.accepted_grid: Exactly 120 closes at 09:31-11:30 and 120 closes at 13:01-15:00 on both sessions; exclude standalone 09:30 and the lunch transition.
selected_candidate.prior_session_rule: Exactly the immediately preceding accepted local market-calendar session; never the previous observed stock day across a suspension or missing partition.
selected_candidate.zero_semantics: Individual exact-zero returns contribute zero squared variation. Both session realized variances must be finite and strictly positive; no epsilon or imputation is permitted.
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Missing unless both exact 240-close stock-session grids exist, all selected closes and 238 derived returns are finite, both realized variances are strictly positive, and the score is finite in (0,1].

decision.next_action: Challenge the fixed cross-session realized-variance stability statistic against all 92 required definitions, then freeze one exact coverage-first no-return protocol before any Campaign061 source, candidate, or comparison value is read.
